notes.title: New DISCORD channel!
notes.content:
Since we receive twitter messages that remain private some of those we would love to make them public in a general chat, so we just created a DISCORD kaleidogames server .

[img]https://discordapp.com/assets/ba74954dde74ff40a32ff58069e78c36.png[/img]
- You will be able to talk directly with us.
- Give us instant feedback.
- Learn about our new games, patches, secretes and easter eggs. :)
- Sometimes we have give aways too. :)
- Also you could earn access to our latest alphas or betas. [b]Get access before anyone else![/b]
- And.... if you are a streamer, you might have access to the games before everyone else.

[h1]Join our server now![/h1]
https://discordapp.com/invite/f8wWFmV

Thank you, see you in the leaderboards!

After over a year without patches, the game was fine as it was but there was room to change a couple of things.


[h1]FIXES/ IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
- Game window allows to be resized.
- There is a new mode called : Fullscreen (Windowed). This was created to solve a few incompatibility issues with some drivers.

- Performance improvements.

- First few levels tutorial have been smoothed out. Less warnings should appear but game play is a little bit more intense now.

- [url=store.steampowered.com/app/484930/Beekyr_Reloaded/]Beekyr Reloaded[/url] banner appears now if you don't have it yet. What are you waiting for? ːsteamhappyː  It's a great game. You can get itvery cheap if you get it through [url=store.steampowered.com/bundle/5415/KaleidoGames__Awesome_Shmups_Bundle_1/]this bundle.[/url]

We hope you enjoy the update.

Thanks for playing!

Remember we created a Kaleidogames Steam Group. Please join us:
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/KaleidoGames

notes.title: Patch 1.3.4
notes.content:
After over a year without patches, here is what needed to be done.


[h1]FIXES:[/h1]

- Fixes some small achievements issues.

- Performance improvements. The game shouldn't slow down after playing a long game.

- The [u]hidden final ship[/u] can be selected now.


[h1]ADDED FEATURES:[/h1]

[b]Vortex Attack 40 Stages![/b]
You can play quicker games by pressing SLOW + FIRE when starting a new game, you will get to the later levels in less time but beware you might get there with less powerups...


We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Awesome patch 1.3
notes.content:
Kaleidogames brings you the latest and best Vortex Attack update. Get ready to enhance your game to 1.3.

[i]This patch makes the game future proof, so it might be the last one.[/i]

[h1]Ships balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Beekyr 
   [*]Verminest
   [*]Kromaia
   [*][i]Snipper-bullet-hell[/i] enemies will shot slightly less but will deliver faster bullets instead
   [*]Some of the bosses are a bit harder to beat now
[/list]

[h1]Added:[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Some social texts in main menu (game needs your help)
   [*]2 new enemy types (we call them the [i]riot hoses[/i])
   [*]5 special stage types
   [*]3 health capsules classified depending how much energy they heal
   [*]4 score capsules, classified how much score they give
[/list]

[h1]Improved:[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Some boss graphics
   [*]Some ship animations
   [*]Some vortex graphics
   [*]Steam title images
   [*]Some achievements are more accessible now
   [*]Later stages are not that long any more
[/list]

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Player ship won't become invincible till the end of the stage sometimes
   [*][i]Retro mode[/i] low performance problem
   [*]Asteroids never reached left side of the screen
[/list]

[h1]Removed:[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Help button from menu during game-play.
[/list]

[h1]Overall:[/h1]
[list]
   [*]A lot more fun. 
[/list]

[b]Please tell your friends about Vortex Attack!
And... see you at the hi-scores table![/b]

[i]Enjoy![/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
Hey we did it again. We realized that online scores system would only work for 2015 so we were forced to update the game once again... 

So we used it as an excuse to improve a few things. Yay! ːsteammockingː

ːhealth_powerupː [b]We added button tags.[/b] We were very surprised that not many people played the FREE TOURNAMENTS. Which is strange we as have very cool prizes and very enjoyable game modes. Maybe people didn't know about them as it didn't say anywhere the word "TOURNAMENT".

ːhealth_powerupː [b]Gameplay: Sectors 2,3, 4 and 5 are more interesting to play[/b]. Before they used to be, for some players, stages that they had to go through to get to the real fun game, for expert players they weren't much of a challenge.

ːhealth_powerupː We also made  [b]some small tweaks in the power-ups system [/b].

ːhealth_powerupː We [b]updated[/b] some vortices' [b]graphics[/b] and some really tiny tweaks in player ships.

ːhealth_powerupː  [b]RETRO MODE:[/b] It has been made more accessible and authentic.
We added the retro mode button in the main menu.  Previously it was hidden in options.

Note about this mode: 
"Retro mode" in Vortex Attack changes the textures, transitions between stages, removes all modern hints and changes other effects.
It changes the feeling of the game but, in reality, the game-play remains the same as the non-retro. So you can play and score for hi-scores or tournaments.

ːlevelup_powerupː Beware! We will find a bug somewhere and we will end up upgrading again. Until then.... have happy blasting away all those minions and scoring high! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Final patch to 1.2
notes.content:
We have fixed the latest small problems which include:

- Space-worms that appear in the lower part of the screen are a bit easier to handle now.
- Ships balance.
- Blaxar, has been changed to shot more times, and more powerful but less spread.
- Ships health bug: after collecting a level-up, ship's health was not being upgraded.


1.2 is possibly the latest update. We might update more but we don't think it's worth changing anything else.

Yep that's right, no more updates, the game is near the perfection we wanted. It's fair, fun and very (re) playable.
If there is a massive volume of new users we might update things to add more secrets or achievements to unlock. 

So...
ENJOY the game and see you at the hi-scores and the arcades.


Note: We will keep fixing bugs if you find any.

notes.title: Upgrade to 1.1.6
notes.content:
New exciting upgrades:
[list][*]Now fully compatible with Steam's Big Picture
[*]Faster game-play overall
[*]Some performance and graphic upgrades
[*]Retro Mode enabled (fix)
[*]Extra credits (to play more)
[*]Small multi player difficulty game-play balance fixes
[*]Some typos corrected
[*]Better tutorials
[*]Small navigation fixes
[/list]

[h1]Retro Mode[/h1]
Finish the game (level 50+) and a new option will appear in your options menu.

[h1]Extra credits[/h1]
Every 10 levels after Level 50 you will get an extra credit on every new game.


[h1][u]A final note about this patch[/u][/h1]
It has everything people have asked for. We are happy with this now. This means that this should be the FINAL update.

But if you think there is room for upgrades please let us know!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update to 1.1.0
notes.content:
Very nice upgrade indeed.

- [b]Translated to JAPANESE![/b]

- [b]Better game performance[/b], older computers can play this game better.

- [b]Retro Mode added[/b]. Reach level 51 and you should find it in options from the main menu.

- [b]Benchmark improved[/b] but, we are aware that going through the benchmark more than once it will return worst scores. 

- [b]Better particles system and graphics[/b]: It all looks tidier: now instead of lines we have smoke and fire coming out the vortex. We can display even more particles at lower processing cost.

- Added: Warning to Asteroids field.

- Gamepad rebinder fix. 

- Some other small fixes

notes.title: World Championship Series has started!
notes.content:
[h1]World Championship series has started.[/h1]It's free to enter: by just buying the game in Steam is enough. 
We want this championship be the first of many. While there are many players playing them we will carry on organizing new tournaments.

[h1]Welcome to the [i]League of the Extraordinary Vortices[/i].[/h1]
[img]http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-_ZlsQddU1xo/VflRD_rhKMI/AAAAAAAAA1s/OrqDwSBrj1E/s1600/prizes-sponsor_poster_v2.jpg[/img]

After all, it's more or less a spin-off [b]Galaga™[/b] with a lot of extras that modern technology allows us to implement today. But, we have gone a step further and we have created the tournaments system where anybody can create a tournament with its own rules. With this, we are organizing now the first Vortex Attack World championship and everybody is invited to join it. No bad for a one man band, [i]Indie developer [/i], right?[h1] [/h1][h1]Prizes and sponsors:[/h1]This first series has already 9 sponsors* giving over 19 prizes distributed in 3 winners.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
Hello everybody,
We have updated again Vortex Attack!

[h1][b]Enjoy the free and better contents![/b][/h1]

This time we have improved and added a ton of things to the game:

[h1]GAME PLAY UPDATES[/h1]
- [b]Improved the player' ships graphics[/b]. They are much nicer looking than ever.
- Toggling full-screen [b]won't not kick players out[/b] from hi-scores.
- [b]Game detail auto adapts now[/b]. It decreases graphics quality if detects the game is running slow. If the detail level is at its lowers, it will kick the player out the steam records.
[i]You need to pass the test at least once but you can manually change detail level from menu.[/i]
- Improved some GUI elements.
- Small gameplay tweaks:

notes.title: Participate in the betas
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

We are uploading new exciting unique experimental versions for you to test them out before anybody else does!

They might have features that never see the light, who knows?

[H1]How to access them.[/H1]
Just enable beta by:

1-  right clicking on Vortex Attack logo in your library.
2- Press properties
3- Clicks betas tab
4- Opt-in by selecting beta in the drop down menu
5- no password! (till release date)

Enjoy!
